name: vscode-sieve-formatter
description: Syntax highlighting and formatter for Sieve email filter scripts: trailing comma removal, list expansion, block indentation, and more.

sieve.formatter.expandLists.description: Expand string lists with 2 or more items to one-item-per-line, and normalise indentation of already-multi-line lists. Disable to leave all list formatting untouched.

sieve.formatter.alwaysExpandRequire.description: Expand the require list to multi-line when it contains 2 or more extensions, using the same rule as other lists. Has no effect when expandLists is disabled.

sieve.formatter.indentBlocks.description: Re-indent the contents of if, elsif, and else blocks based on brace nesting depth.

sieve.formatter.joinElsifElse.description: When elsif or else appears on its own line after a }, join it onto the same line as the } so that control flow reads as a single construct.

sieve.formatter.normalizeBlankLines.description: Collapse runs of more than one consecutive blank line into a single blank line.

sieve.formatter.sortRequire.description: Sort the extensions inside require [...] alphabetically. Has no effect on a bare require "string" or a single-extension list.

scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test
